myparcel.accountHint: Required to export orders via MyParcel's Orders API before creating a label -- find these in your MyParcel account settings.
myparcel.autoPrintHint: Opens the print dialog automatically once a label is created, instead of requiring a manual click. You still pick the printer yourself -- this isn't silent printing.
myparcel.exportOrdersHint: When on, creating a shipment also registers the order via MyParcel's Orders API, so it appears on MyParcel's own Orders page. Off by default -- it shares the full order (line items, prices) with MyParcel, which isn't needed just to print a label.
myparcel.insureHint: Insured amount is always the order's own value, computed automatically when the label is created -- not a fixed figure set here. Insuring a shipment forces "Signature required" and "Only recipient" -- required by MyParcel whenever insurance is set.
myparcel.intro: Paste your MyParcel API key. No redirect step -- MyParcel authenticates via a single API key.
myparcel.labelSizeHint: Default only -- staff can pick a different size on each print.
myparcel.noSecret: No secret generated yet -- Create a subscription below needs one first (MyParcel embeds it as part of the delivery URL's path, since MyParcel signs nothing).
myparcel.registered: Registered -- MyParcel is now sending shipment_status_change webhooks to CommerceOS.
myparcel.registerFailed: Failed to register webhook with MyParcel
myparcel.secretWarning: This won't be shown again -- generate a new one if you lose it.
myparcel.webhooksIntro: Registers CommerceOS's own delivery URL with MyParcel for shipment_status_change -- this is what makes MyParcel actually start sending shipment updates here.
